name: JARVIS Shell (System)
description: Run programs and shell scripts with system-level (sudo) privileges. Use for package management, system updates, systemd, and any command that requires elevated privileges.
summary: System-level shell execution for JARVIS. Installed to /usr/share/mcp and runs with sudo access. Use for pacman, apt, systemctl, and other privileged operations.

tools.name: execute_command
tools.description: Execute a program with system privileges and return its stdout, stderr, and exit code

tools.name: execute_script
tools.description: Execute a multi-line shell script with system privileges via /bin/sh
